query:
UPDATE entity_properties
        SET
            values = jsonb_set(
                values,
                '{value}',
                COALESCE(
                    (
                        SELECT jsonb_agg(elem)
                        FROM jsonb_array_elements(values -> 'value') AS elem
                        WHERE NOT (to_jsonb($2::text[]) @> elem)
                    ),
                    '[]'::jsonb
                )
            ),
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE property_definition_id = $1
          AND values -> 'value' ?| $2::text[]
